# search-export: `ExportDatasetReport`

The `data` payload of `openreadout search INDEX_DIR QUERY --export OUT --json` (also `OUT/datasheet.json`), inside the [envelope](envelope.md).

`datasheet.json`, and the payload of `search --export --json`.

JSON Schema: [`docs/schema/search-export.schema.json`](https://github.com/openreadout/openreadout/blob/main/docs/schema/search-export.schema.json) · also printed by `openreadout self schema search-export`.

## Fields

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `schema_version` | `string` | yes | Datasheet schema version. |
| `output` | `string` | yes | The output directory. |
| `created_at` | `string` | yes | When the export finished. |
| `tool` | `string` | yes | Tool and version. |
| `query` | `string` | yes | The query. |
| `index_dir` | `string` | yes | The index it came from. |
| `index_roots` | array of `string` | yes | The index's roots. |
| `index_updated_at` | `string` | yes | When the index was written. |
| `table_format` | [`TableFormat`](#tableformat) | yes | Tables written as `parquet` or `csv`. |
| `redaction` | `string` | yes | Whether personal data was redacted, and how. |
| `counts` | object: string → `integer` (uint64) | yes | Totals over the exported data sets. |
| `formats` | object: string → `integer` (uint64) | yes | Data sets per source format. |

| `resumed` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Data sets reused from an earlier, interrupted run. |

| `skipped` | array of [`SkippedDataset`](#skippeddataset) | yes | Data sets that could not be exported. |
| `verified` | `boolean` | yes | Every output verified. |

## Types

### TableFormat

File format for tables, traces and spectra.

| value | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `"parquet"` | Apache Parquet (Snappy). |
| `"csv"` | Comma-separated values. |

### ExportedDataset

One exported data set.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Output id (file-name prefix). |
| `source` | `string` | yes | Source path. |
| `format` | `string` | yes | Source format id. |
| `family` | `string` | yes | Source family. |
| `size_bytes` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Source bytes. |
| `fingerprint` | `string` or `null` |  | Source content fingerprint (from the index). |
| `counts` | object: string → `integer` (uint64) | yes | Images, planes, tables, table rows, traces, trace samples, spectra runs, spectra. |
| `outputs` | array of [`OutputFile`](#outputfile) | yes | Files written. |
| `experiment` | any JSON |  | The experiment (redacted when asked), with provenance. |
| `license` | [`LicenseInfo`](#licenseinfo) or `null` |  | Licence, when known. |
| `pii` | array of [`PiiFlag`](#piiflag) |  | Personal-data flags (field, kind, rule). |
| `redacted_values` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Values replaced by redaction. |
| `notes` | array of `string` |  | Things to know (parts that could not be exported). |

### OutputFile

One written file.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `file` | `string` | yes | Path relative to the output directory. |
| `kind` | `string` | yes | `metadata`, `image`, `table`, `trace` or `spectra`. |
| `rows` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Rows (tables, traces, spectra) or planes (images). |
| `columns` | array of `string` |  | Columns written (tables, traces, spectra). |
| `bytes` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Bytes on disk. |
| `digest` | `string` |  | xxh3-64 digest of every value written (rows in order), hex; empty for images. |
| `verified` | `boolean` | yes | Read back and compared. |

### LicenseInfo

The licence of a data set, when known.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `spdx` | `string` or `null` |  | SPDX id, when recognised (`CC-BY-4.0`, `CC0-1.0`, `MIT`, ...). |
| `source` | `string` | yes | Where it came from: `user` (`--license`) or the licence file's path. |

### PiiFlag

One personal-data flag: which field, what kind, which rule. The value itself is never
stored in the index.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `field` | `string` | yes | Path of the field in the `info` JSON (`experiment.acquisition.operator`, `tables[0].extra.vendor_keywords.EXPORT.EXPORT USER NAME`). |
| `kind` | `string` | yes | `person_name`, `email`, `phone`, `patient_id`, `date_of_birth` or `free_text`. |
| `rule` | `string` | yes | The rule that fired (`book/src/guides/lab-shares.md#personal-data`). |

### SkippedDataset

A data set that could not be exported.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | `string` | yes | Source path. |
| `reason` | `string` | yes | Why. |
